---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a feature for PortLens
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Problem / motivation**
What problem are you trying to solve, and why is it important? A concrete
example (the exact command you wish worked) helps the most.

**Proposed behavior**
Describe the feature as a user would experience it. Include the command syntax
you imagine.

**Alternatives**
What have you tried already? Any workarounds?

**Additional context**
Anything else — links, related issues, screenshots.

**Contributor note**
New contributors welcome! See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the
project layout, conventions, and how a feature maps to the code.
